behavior: The owner can make a new invoice repeat every month on New invoice, and see and stop the retainer on the invoice page
acceptance: New invoice has a Repeat every month checkbox and, when checked, an optional Last due date; the invoice is created with repeat (and endDate when picked); checked without a due date or client email it shows an error on the checkbox and sends nothing; Request money and Duplicate leave it off.

Each invoice of a retainer shows Repeats every month in Billed to with the next due date and the day it is emailed, or when it ended or was stopped; Stop repeating asks in a dialog, calls repeat/stop, shows a toast and moves focus to the stopped line.
The live e2e creates a repeating invoice, sees the schedule, stops it, and leaves no running retainer; axe finds no serious or critical violations and the phone form fits 390 px.
DESIGN.md describes the checkbox and the Billed to row; the web schema reads retainer.
notes:
2026-10-18 review fail by reviewer: FAIL. One copy defect makes accept 2 and R-99 false.

Blocking:
1. The end date is shown as if it were an invoice's due date, but the API treats it only as a limit (openapi.yaml:1397, "last due date a month may have"). The form lets the owner pick any day on or after the due date.
- invoices-copy.ts:436 ("The last is due X") and repeats-monthly.tsx:51-53 show it while the retainer runs. Example from F229-repeats-desk.png and F229-stop-dialog.png: "Next invoice due Dec 1, 2026 ... The last is due Apr 30, 2027". Monthly invoices fall on the 1st, so the last one is due Apr 1 and no invoice is due Apr 30.
- invoices-copy.ts:437 ("The last invoice was due X") and repeats-monthly.tsx:54-55 show it once the retainer ends. The backend reports "ended" as soon as the next month falls after the end date (retainers.go:181-197). I checked this rule with read-only SQL: first due 2026-12-01, end 2027-04-30, today 2027-03-25 gives next 2027-05-01, running=false. So on Mar 25 the page says "The last invoice was due Apr 30, 2027". That date is wrong, and it uses past tense for an invoice due in the future. Even when the end date falls on the due day, the past tense is wrong for the 7 days before that invoice is due.
- Fix: word endDate as a limit, for example "No invoice is due after X" while running and "Ended. No invoice is due after X" once ended. Then update DESIGN.md:353-354 to match ("the last due date if set" and "says when"). The form hint at invoices-copy.ts:146 already words it correctly.

Checked and correct:
- Contract: the request repeat {endDate?} (schemas/invoices.ts:221) and the response retainer {endDate, nextDueDate, nextOn, stoppedAt}, nullable (schemas/invoices.ts:153-158, 188), match openapi.yaml:1384-1398, 1532-1543 and invoiceapi/model.go:150-156. stopRepeat POSTs .../repeat/stop and parses the Invoice. invalidField maps "repeat needs ..." to "repeat" and "repeat.endDate must ..." to "repeat.endDate" (constants/invoices.ts:141-142), and both have field errors.
- Form: an error and focus on the checkbox without a due date or email. The end date is checked against the due date at submit. Request money has no checkbox. Duplicate starts unchecked. The idempotency key follows the body, so changing repeat gets a new key.
- RepeatsMonthly follows the cancel dialog in invoice-actions.tsx: the same Dialog, Keep/Stop buttons, a role=alert error that keeps the dialog open, and SendToClient's focus-after-refetch pattern. Unit tests (33), tsc and biome pass. docs-check shows 0 errors.
- Dev DB has 0 running retainers. The 2 retainers from the e2e runs are both stopped.

Non-blocking:
- e2e invoices.spec.ts:210 picks no Last due date. If a run fails between creating the invoice and stopping it (about 100 lines later), the retainer runs forever. It would make monthly invoices with 60-day checkouts and real emails, against D-85. Picking a Last due date would cap that and also cover endDate end to end.
- new-invoice-form.tsx:325 shows the 422 for the 50-retainer cap only as the general "Check them and try again", because invalidField reads the word "a". It does not say the cap is reached.
- Unchecking Repeat leaves any repeat.endDate error in the errors map (new-invoice-form.tsx:686-688), so it shows again when the box is checked.
- The repeats screenshots mock a retainer onto an invoice with no client email, which the API can't produce. The phone e2e never opens Last due date or the Repeats row at 390 px; only the screenshot covers them.
- The hint at invoices-copy.ts:144 ("due on this day") doesn't say that shorter months use their last day. It is not wrong.
